title: Instrument Tuber
description:
***EDUCATION PREFERRED - HIGH SCHOOL DIPLOMA OR GED***

PROJECT DURATION: APPROXIMATELY 3-4 MONTHS

SCHEDULE: BOTH THE DAY SHIFT AND THE NIGHT SHIFT ARE AVAILABLE TO FILL. IDEALLY, WE WANT CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE AVAILABILITY TO WORK EITHER SHIFT.
- DAY SHIFT - 5:00 AM TO 5:30 PM (30-MINUTE LUNCH)
- NIGHT SHIFT - 5:00 PM TO 5:00 AM (30-MINUTE LUNCH)

***THE START AND END TIME OF THE SHIFT WILL DEPEND ON PART ARRIVALS***

ON-SITE BEND TEST WILL BE REQUIRED DURING THE ON-SITE INTERVIEW. CANDIDATES DO NOT NEED TO BRING THEIR OWN TOOLS. FORMER WORKERS DO NOT NEED TO BE RETESTED.

TOP SKILLS/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED (MUST BE SHOWN ON ALL RESUMES):
- Previous Instrumentation experience in Swagelok stainless steel tubing
- Tubing ranges from a quarter inch to 1 inch- Hydraulic Power Unit (HPU) experience
- Ability to read hydraulic schematics
- Ability to fit, cut, and bend stainless steel tubing without errors
- 2-3 years of experience in Oil and Gas is highly preferred
- Previous experience with NOV's competitors such as Cameron, Schlumberger with HPU, surface equipment and land equipment experience
- Previous experience working with Swagelok (brand) Stainless Steel Tubing - high quality tubing is highly preferred

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Plan layout and installation in accordance with instructions or work requirements using drawings, blueprints, sketches and manual.
- Measures thread, cuts and assemble cable tray and cable tray support systems.
- Install tubing and clamps into cable tray systems.
- Measure, cut, bend, thread, assemble and install tubing and piping.
- Plan and coordinate daily work with limited supervision.
- Perform other work-related tasks as assigned.
- Comply with all NOV Company and HSE policies and procedures

FACILITY/GROUP SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Utilize hand, hydraulic, and power tools.
- Drill and tap holes in structures and attach brackets, guards, etc. per the assemble drawing.
- Operate man lifts, scissor lifts, overhead cranes, band saws, hose cutting/crimping devices, pressure pumps, and hydraulic pumping units when necessary.
- Inspect and maintain tools.
- Follow all 6S guidelines and ensure that they are met.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
- Able to lift 30 lbs.
- Work at heights up to 65 feet
- Will be standing, sitting and walking throughout the workday.
- Work in a non-climate control environment.

description:

Role Summary
Experience Range - 8-10 years
We are seeking a Software Engineer with strong Python and MLOps foundations to build, enhance, and stabilize a production‐grade AI/ML platform supporting model training, validation, deployment, and orchestration at enterprise scale.
This role goes beyond scripting or notebook‐driven ML. You will work in a class‐based, API‐driven, CI/CD‐enforced MLOps ecosystem, contributing to reusable libraries, ML workflows, secure endpoints, JSON‐schema‐driven interfaces, and automated pipelines aligned with Chevron's evolving GitHub Actions strategy.

Key Responsibilities
Core Engineering & MLOps
- Design, build, and maintain production‐grade Python services using sound object‐oriented principles (SOLID, separation of concerns, reusability).
Contribute to and extend the enterprise MLOps pipeline supporting:
- Model training, validation, and registration
- Azure ML–based execution
- Parameterized workflow orchestration
- CI/CD‐driven deployments
Implement and maintain ML inference endpoints, with focus on:
-High‐performance I/O using async programming and concurrency
-Clean request/response contracts driven by JSON schemas
-Robust validation and error handling
Develop well‐defined APIs (REST) with:
-OpenAPI / Swagger documentation
-Version‐aware schemas and backward compatibility considerations
Support platform evolution from Azure Pipelines to GitHub Actions, contributing to:
-Pipeline re‐architecture
-Build, test, and release automation
-Secure artifact promotion across environments

Data, ML & Storage

Work with Pandas and Polars for feature handling, transformations, and data preparation.
Support ML workflows leveraging Scikit‐Learn models and pipelines.
Integrate with Azure Blob Storage and Azure Data Lake for model artifacts, datasets, and metadata.
(Nice to have) Contribute to solutions involving Azure Cosmos DB for metadata or workflow state tracking.

Quality, Testing & Maintainability

Write clean, maintainable, and testable code—optimizing for long‐term platform health over short‐term delivery speed.
Expand and strengthen the automated test suite, including:
-PyTest‐based unit and integration tests
-Validation of pipelines, schemas, and services
Advocate for and gradually adopt Test‐Driven Development (TDD) practices across the codebase.
Actively reduce technical debt in a legacy‐heavy environment by:
-Refactoring duplicated or brittle code
-Introducing shared libraries and abstractions
-Improving documentation and developer ergonomics

Required Technical Skills

Advanced Python
-Class‐based design, modular architecture, reusable components
-Not "script‐only” or notebook‐centric development
API Development
-RESTful services, endpoint performance tuning
-OpenAPI / Swagger documentation
Async Programming
-Async/await, concurrency, threading for I/O‐heavy workloads
CI/CD
-Azure Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions
-Experience evolving pipelines, not just consuming them
Data & ML
-Pandas / Polars
-Scikit‐Learn
Testing
-PyTest
-Strong appreciation for automated testing as a quality gate
Schema‐Driven Development
-JSON schemas for configuration, workflow parameters, and APIs
-Experience updating and managing schema evolution

Nice‐to‐Have Skills

Azure ML SDK (training, pipelines, model registration)
Pydantic for request/response validation
Azure Cosmos DB
Schema versioning strategies
Experience with large, shared enterprise codebases

Desired Qualities & Mindset
Takes Initiative
-Understands how individual stories connect to platform‐level objectives.
-Proactively improves systems instead of waiting for direction.
Strong Debugger
-Comfortable tracing failures across pipelines, services, storage, and infrastructure.
-Attempts root‐cause analysis before escalating issues.
Values Code Quality
-Will not compromise maintainability for speed.
-Actively resists adding to technical debt.
Engineering Craftsmanship
-Cares about design, clarity, and long‐term scalability.
-Sees MLOps as software engineering, not just ML enablement.
Advocates for Better Practices
-Encourages testability, consistency, and clean abstractions—even in legacy environments.

title: A&T Technician
description:
Scope: Within the framework of a team-based organization, perform various hydraulic assembly, electrical component assembly, test and process based operations on complex hydraulic components, assemblies and systems supporting new production and repair and overhaul activity. Assembly activity utilizes a variety of mechanical and electronic measurement equipment and specialized fixtures, tooling, gauging and torque mechanisms to obtain desired build requirements. The individual is required to work from drawings, work instructions, parts lists or other instruction and provide detailed written communication defining performance results and/or situational circumstances. title: Case Manager
description:
Description

The Case Manager owns a high-volume caseload of legal cases from initiation through resolution. This role is the central point of contact for attorneys, clients, and internal departments, requiring strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and professional communication with legal counsel and cross-functional stakeholders on behalf of Strategic Legal Practices.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage a high-volume caseload end-to-end, including documentation, processing, follow-up, and closure.
  • Maintain accurate case records in the case management system, ensuring all milestones, deadlines, and correspondence are logged in real time.
  • Prioritize and triage cases based on urgency, compliance deadlines, and attorney direction; escalate issues proactively to avoid delays.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between Strategic Legal Practices and assigned attorneys, providing timely updates on case strategy, status, and required actions.
  • Prepare case files, documentation packages, and correspondence for attorney review; respond promptly to all attorney requests.
  • Coordinate across departments — including
  • compliance, client services, paralegal support, and billing — to move cases forward efficiently.
  • Serve as a professional point of contact for clients, delivering clear updates on status, timelines, and documentation needs.
  • Ensure all files are complete and compliant with program and regulatory standards; support audits and compliance reviews as needed.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & EXPECTATIONS

  • High-volume, production-oriented role with clear caseload benchmarks and quality standards.
  • Daily interaction with attorneys and legal staff; professional, responsive communication is essential.
  • Occasional overtime may be required during peak periods or to meet critical deadlines.
  • Strict confidentiality regarding sensitive client and legal information is required at all times.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of experience in case management, legal support, or a related field; law firm or legal services environment strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to manage a high-volume caseload with competing deadlines in a fast-paced setting.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable corresponding directly with attorneys and legal staff.
  • High attention to detail; proficiency with case management software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with legal workflows, court procedures, or compliance frameworks a plus.
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Paralegal Studies, or a related field preferred.

Solid GIS data editing skills and knowledge.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Description: Mechanical Engineer – Electromechanical Design (CCA & Harness)

CCA BOARD LAYOUT & DESIGN IS REQUIRED FOR THESE ROLES.

4/10 schedule. Every Friday off.

If you thrive in a fast‐paced, cross‐disciplinary environment and have a passion for reliable electronic system design, we invite you to apply.

We are looking for Electromechanical Engineers with extensive experience in designing and integrating complex electronic hardware.
The roles focus on creating detailed mechanical layouts for Circuit Card Assembly (CCA) boards, selecting appropriate connectors, and ensuring fit, clearance, and tolerance compliance using PTC Creo and Windchill.
You will troubleshoot manufacturing issues, support DFM/DFA reviews, define and oversee test plans, and manage board integration with enclosures.
Cable and harness design, as well as Zuken experience, are strong pluses.
Documentation, BOM management, and cross‐functional collaboration with mechanical, electrical, systems, reliability, and manufacturing teams are essential.

Required Experience:

Must have a Bachelor degree (or higher) in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Must have at least 3 years of hands on experience with CCA board mechanical design, connector selection, and manufacturing support.
Must have at least 3 years of hands on experience with Creo and Windchill
Must have at least 3 years of hands on experience with Zuken, IPC standards, and aerospace/defense product cycles
Strong problem‐solving, communication, and project‐management skills are a must, as is the ability to produce high‐quality design documentation and guide test and integration activities.
